title: Meta commits to buy up to $15B of extra Nebius capacity

sources.quote: Furthermore, in connection with access to these NVIDIA Vera Rubin deployments, Meta has committed to purchase additional available compute capacity across certain upcoming Nebius clusters up to a total of $15 billion over a five-year period.

explain: On top of its $12 billion deal, Meta agreed to buy up to $15 billion of spare capacity in upcoming Nebius clusters that Nebius cannot sell to other customers. It works like a backstop, so actual spending may be lower.
